note: Which recordings and chart each node plays. audio = the pack whose stems are heard, chart = the pack whose cues are played (nodes at one depth may chart different packs, each world its own song; they play the same difficulty tier, tier = min(depth, 4), of their own chart pack; the validators warn about it). treatment = a name from run.json treatments (none where the level has its own recording). temporary = true for stand-ins awaiting the owner's own recordings. Replace a node's music by editing audio/chart here after importing a pack (docs/MUSIC_IMPORT.md); node ids never change.
